```{ojs}
IDX = FileAttachment("../data/inst_index.csv").csv({typed: true}).then(a => a.map(d => ({...d, label: d.campuses > 1 ? `${d.name} + ${d.campuses - 1} other campus${d.campuses > 2 ? "es" : ""}` : d.name})))
BANDS = FileAttachment("../data/bands.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

::: {.cs-lead}
Search for a college to see its staff per 1,000 students, enrollment and spending per student, year by year, against the **middle half of its sector** (the 25th to 75th percentile of every college in the sector reporting that year). The cards give its own FY2013–24 decomposition: how much of any change in staff per student came from staff and how much from students.
:::

::: {.cs-links}
Read more: [white paper §4](../paper/index.qmd#sec-4) (staffing and spending since 2012) and [§7](../paper/index.qmd#sec-7) (research and medical centers). Substack posts: Post 1 and Post 4 (links on publication).
:::

```{ojs}
viewof secF = Inputs.select(["all", ...SECTORS.map(s => s.k)], {format: k => k === "all" ? "All sectors" : SECL[k], value: param("sector", "all"), label: "Sector"})
viewof stF = Inputs.select(["all", ...STLIST], {format: s => s === "all" ? "All states" : STNAME[s], value: param("st", "all"), label: "State"})
viewof q = Inputs.search(IDX.filter(d => (secF === "all" || d.sec === secF) && (stF === "all" || d.st === stF)), {placeholder: "Search by name, e.g. Purdue", label: "Search"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof pick = Inputs.table(q, {
  columns: ["label", "st", "sec", "fte24", "d_staff", "d_fte", "d_ratio"],
  header: {label: "Institution", st: "State", sec: "Sector", fte24: "Fall FTE FY2024", d_staff: "Staff FY13→24", d_fte: "FTE FY13→24", d_ratio: "Staff per student FY13→24"},
  format: {sec: k => SECL[k], fte24: f0, d_staff: s1, d_fte: s1, d_ratio: s1},
  width: {label: 300}, layout: "auto",
  sort: "fte24", reverse: true, rows: 8, multiple: false,
  value: q.find(d => String(d.id) === param("id", "243780")) ?? d3.greatest(q, d => d.fte24 ?? 0)
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
P = pick ? d3.csv(`../data/inst/${pick.st}.csv`, d3.autoType) : []
I = pick ? P.filter(d => d.id === pick.id) : []
syncI = { if (pick) setParam("id", pick.id); setParam("sector", secF === "all" ? null : secF); setParam("st", stF === "all" ? null : stF); return true; }
band = (m) => pick ? BANDS.filter(d => d.sec === pick.sec && d.m === m) : []
```

```{ojs}
{
  if (!pick) return md`*Choose an institution in the table.*`;
  const amc = pick.amc === "hosp" ? "Owns a hospital (academic medical center). Most hospital employees are not in IPEDS staff counts, but a few owners report some of them, and staff per student at hospital owners averages about twice that at research universities without a medical school." : pick.amc === "med" ? "Has a medical school but no owned hospital in its IPEDS reporting." : "";
  const set = pick.s11 ? "In the S11 surviving set used for the FY2013–24 decomposition." : "Not in the S11 surviving set (it lacks a Delta Cost 11-year matched campus or a year of staff or enrollment), so it is excluded from sector aggregates on the other pages.";
  const sys = pick.campuses > 1 ? ` This unit combines ${pick.campuses} IPEDS campuses${pick.campuses >= 4 ? " (a system the Delta Cost Project reported as one unit, kept whole for every year)" : " that merged or report together"}.` : "";
  return md`### ${pick.label}
<p class="cs-note">${SECL[pick.sec]}, ${STNAME[pick.st] ?? pick.st}${pick.peer === "flag" ? " · state flagship" : pick.peer === "reg" ? " · regional public" : pick.peer === "small" ? " · small private (<2,000 FTE in FY2012)" : ""}. ${set}${sys} ${amc}</p>
<div class="cs-kpis">
<div class="cs-kpi"><div class="v">${s1(pick.d_ratio)}</div><div class="l">change in staff per student, FY2013→24 (log points ≈ %)</div></div>
<div class="cs-kpi"><div class="v">${s1(pick.d_staff)}</div><div class="l">change in staff (total headcount)</div></div>
<div class="cs-kpi"><div class="v">${s1(pick.d_fte)}</div><div class="l">change in fall FTE students (${f0(pick.fte13)} → ${f0(pick.fte24)})</div></div>
<div class="cs-kpi"><div class="v">${s1(pick.d_oncampus)}</div><div class="l">change in on-campus FTE (excluding exclusively online students)</div></div>

```

```{ojs}
viewof im = Inputs.select(new Map([["All employees (headcount)", "tot"], ["Full-time faculty", "ftf"], ["Part-time faculty", "ptf"], ["Non-faculty staff", "nfc"], ["EAM", "eam"], ["Professional staff", "pro"], ["Nonprofessional staff", "npr"], ["EAM + professional", "ep"]]), {value: param("m", "tot"), label: "Staff category"})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
IBRK = new Set(["eam", "pro", "npr", "ep"])
bandChart = (m, {w, h = 280, title, fmt = f0, ylab, era: useEra = false}) => {
  const me = I.filter(d => d[m] != null && isFinite(d[m])).map(d => ({...d, v: d[m], e: useEra ? era(d.fy) : "a"}));
  const b = band(m).map(d => ({...d, e: useEra ? era(d.fy) : "a"}));
  if (!me.length) return html`<div style="width:${w}px"><h4 style="font-size:1rem;margin:.3rem 0">${title}</h4><p class="cs-note">No data reported for this institution.</p></div>`;
  const x0 = d3.min(me, d => d.fy) - 1;
  const bb = b.filter(d => d.fy >= x0);
  return Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: h, marginLeft: 52, marginTop: 28, title,
    x: {...yearAxis, domain: [x0, 2026]}, y: {grid: true, label: ylab, tickFormat: fmt === usd ? "$,.0f" : null},
    marks: [
      useEra ? Plot.ruleX([2012.5], {stroke: BREAKC, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}) : null,
      Plot.areaY(bb, {x: "fy", y1: "p25", y2: "p75", z: "e", fill: SECC[pick.sec], fillOpacity: 0.15}),
      Plot.lineY(bb, {x: "fy", y: "p50", z: "e", stroke: SECC[pick.sec], strokeDasharray: "4,3", strokeWidth: 1.3}),
      Plot.lineY(me, {x: "fy", y: "v", z: "e", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 2.2}),
      Plot.dot(me, {x: "fy", y: "v", r: 2.5, fill: INK}),
      Plot.tip(me, Plot.pointerX({x: "fy", y: "v", title: d => { const s = b.find(x => x.fy === d.fy); return `FY${d.fy}: ${fmt(d.v)}${s ? `\nsector median ${fmt(s.p50)} (middle half ${fmt(s.p25)}–${fmt(s.p75)})` : ""}`; }}))
    ]
  });
}
```

<div class="cs-two">

pick ? bandChart(im, {w: half(width), title: `${new Map([["tot","All employees"],["ftf","Full-time faculty"],["ptf","Part-time faculty"],["nfc","Non-faculty staff"],["eam","EAM"],["pro","Professional staff"],["npr","Nonprofessional staff"],["ep","EAM + professional"]]).get(im)} per 1,000 FTE students`, fmt: f1, ylab: null, era: IBRK.has(im)}) : html``

pick ? bandChart("fte", {w: half(width), title: "Fall FTE students", fmt: f0, ylab: null}) : html``

</div>

::: {.cs-note}
Black line: this institution. Shaded band: middle half of its sector; dashed line: sector median (all institutions in the sector reporting that year, not only surviving ones). Red dashed line: the 2012–13 IPEDS staff-survey redesign; EAM, professional and nonprofessional staff are not comparable across it and are drawn as separate segments.
:::

### Spending per student

```{ojs}
viewof fm = Inputs.select(new Map([["Instruction", "ins"], ["Academic support", "acs"], ["Student services", "sts"], ["Institutional support", "iss"], ["Auxiliary enterprises (housing, dining, etc.)", "aux"]]), {value: param("f", "ins"), label: "Function"})
```

<div class="cs-two">

```{ojs}
pick ? bandChart(fm, {w: half(width), title: `${new Map([["ins","Instruction"],["acs","Academic support"],["sts","Student services"],["iss","Institutional support"],["aux","Auxiliary enterprises"]]).get(fm)} per FTE student (real 2024 $)`, fmt: usd, ylab: null}) : html``
```

```{ojs}
pick ? bandChart("ath", {w: half(width), title: "Athletics spending per FTE student (real 2024 $)", fmt: usd, ylab: null}) : html``
```

</div>

```{ojs}
{
  if (!pick || !I.length) return html``;
  const F = [["ins", "Instruction"], ["acs", "Academic support"], ["sts", "Student services"], ["iss", "Institutional support"], ["aux", "Auxiliary enterprises"], ["ath", "Athletics (EADA)"]];
  const at = (fy, m) => I.find(d => d.fy === fy)?.[m];
  const med = (fy, m) => band(m).find(d => d.fy === fy)?.p50;
  const y0 = 2013, y1 = 2024;
  return html`<div class="cs-scroll"><table class="cs-sectab"><thead><tr><th>Per FTE student, real 2024 $</th><th>FY${y0}</th><th>FY${y1}</th><th>Change</th><th>Sector median FY${y1}</th></tr></thead><tbody>
  ${F.map(([m, l]) => { const a = at(y0, m), b = at(y1, m); return html`<tr><td>${l}</td><td>${usd(a)}</td><td>${usd(b)}</td><td>${a > 0 && b > 0 ? s0(100 * Math.log(b / a)) + " log pts" : "–"}</td><td>${usd(med(y1, m))}</td></tr>`; })}
  </tbody></table></div>`;
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
**Data.** Staff: IPEDS Human Resources (FY *t* = fall *t*−1); students: fall FTE enrollment. Institutions are Delta Cost extension groups: campuses that merged, or that a Delta Cost-era system reported together, are one unit for every year. Spending: IPEDS Finance by function, real 2024 dollars (CPI-U fiscal year), hospital expenses excluded, FY2004 onward (even years before FY2012). Athletics: Equity in Athletics (EADA) total athletic expense, FY2007–2024. FY2024–25 IPEDS values are NCES provisional. Staff per student changes are in log points ×100 (about percent for small changes).
:::

{ syncI; setParam("m", im === "tot" ? null : im); setParam("f", fm === "ins" ? null : fm); return 1; }
